content.title: Successful online order notifies Sarah by email on the phone checkout path
content.intent: Prove that completing a successful online order through the phone checkout flow reaches the success state that should trigger Sarah's email notification for order processing.
content.technique_notes: Techniques applied: equivalence partitioning for the single successful-order representative path; state / flow because the cited behavior occurs only after the checkout journey reaches a successful order state. Risk-judged interaction strength was 3 because money applies to missed orders, but no covering array was needed because this use-case exposed one outcome-changing successful path and the corpus did not define alternative email-routing semantics or failure outcomes to combine.
